state:
**Goal `ext-intl`: Stage 7 (the growth, and a bundle) is on disk; Stage 8, the feature proofs, is next.** Every export of `nvs:intl/icu` is implemented, and each of the eight job classes in `extensions/intl/nvs/` has its Novis half. The embedded sizes are in the component module docs: intl is 9.7 MiB (`extensions/intl/src/lib.rs`) and image is 5.8 MiB (`extensions/image/src/lib.rs`). `the_recorded_growth_matches_the_embedded_components` in `crates/nvs-ext/tests/builtin.rs` holds both within 5%. `a_bundle_calls_both_built_in_components` in `crates/nvs-cli/tests/bundle.rs` passes. It needed `bundle::build` to skip the built-in components' Novis source halves, because the host binary carries them (`crates/nvs-cli/src/bundle.rs`).

What is still red is Stage 8 alone. No `Novis\Intl` member has an `about.md`, examples, an attack, a bench or a Rust `covers:` marker yet. Most have 1 of 2 `.nvst` cases. `bun nv proofs --id '<Class::member>'` prints each owed path.

next.title: the feature proofs, one class at a time
next.note: one file set per class: `docs/examples/novis/Intl-<Class>/`, `tests/hostile/novis/Intl-<Class>/`, `benches/members/novis/Intl-<Class>/`, `tests/conformance/novis/intl-*.nvst`. Copy the shape of the `Image-Codec` trees beside them. Every comment and `about.md` follows `AGENTS.md` § *Text an end user reads*, and `bun nv proofs --comments` checks them before the wrap.

items.text: **`Novis\Intl\Collator` owes nothing** (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`): `sort` and `sortKeys`, each with an about, 3 examples, 1 attack, a bench and a second case. `sort` also needs a Rust test with its `covers:` marker. Source half `extensions/intl/nvs/Collator.nvs:1`.
**`Novis\Intl\NumberFormat` owes nothing**: `percent`, `currency` and `compact`, the same set each. Source half `extensions/intl/nvs/NumberFormat.nvs:1`.

**`Novis\Intl\PluralRules` and `Novis\Intl\RelativeTime` owe nothing**: `cardinal`, `ordinal` and `format`. Source halves `extensions/intl/nvs/PluralRules.nvs:1` and `extensions/intl/nvs/RelativeTime.nvs:1`.

backlog: `Novis\Intl\Icu`, the manifest class, owes proofs for `sentenceSegments`, `resolveLocales` and `negotiate` (`bun nv proofs --id 'Novis\Intl\Icu'`).

`rule:packaging/the-first-party-components-are-built-in`'s *Partly on disk* paragraph still lists only `collateOrder` and `sortKeys` as implemented. Every export is now implemented, and the paragraph should say so.

`rule:packaging/a-nvsx-dependency-embeds-in-the-same-payload`'s *Not on disk* paragraph says the built-in components do not exist yet, and that is stale. A rule edit cannot wrap while `bun nv rules --check` fails on `docs/agent/goals/pdf.md`'s five citations of rules that do not exist yet.

ADR 0277 § 10 says the module doc states whether `compiled_data` is CLDR's whole set or ICU4X's default coverage level. The intl module doc states the size only, and the coverage level is not checked.
